entities.name: Web Browser
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn bracketed box labeled 'Web Browser' at top-left; the user accesses PixelStrings via a regular web browser (Chrome).

entities.name: Web Server / Job Manager
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_6 (849,146), EC2 icon labeled 'WEB SERVER' and 'JOB MANAGER'. Single EC2 instance hosting both the web server and the job manager components.

entities.name: Database
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_5 (1049,151), blue database icon labeled 'DATABASE'. Caches clip metadata; the web server reads from it and the job manager writes to it.

entities.name: IMF
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_4 (1260,153), EC2 icon labeled 'IMF'. Instance performing Interoperable Master Format wrapping of outputs.

entities.name: G3 GPU Cluster
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_3 (1057,363), EC2 instances (multi-instance) icon labeled 'G3' with 'A.M' (asset manager) written on its left and 'WORMHOLE, SPACETIME, DARK ENERGY' written on its right. GPU instances running the processing products; the asset manager runs here and copies clips to/from S3.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_1 (851,517), Lambda icon labeled 'LAMBDA'. Runs MediaInfo to extract clip metadata from the S3 bucket for the job manager.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_2 (658,516), S3 bucket icon labeled 'S3'. Customer-managed bucket holding input clips and receiving output clips.

visual_connections.description: Pink double-headed arrow between the Web Browser box and the EC2 web server icon; the user logs in, enters S3 keys and submits jobs over a regular internet connection.
Pink double-headed arrow between the 'WEB SERVER' label and 'DATABASE'; the web server reads metadata from the database.
Second pink arrow from the 'JOB MANAGER' label to 'DATABASE' (arrowheads at the job manager end and up into the database); the job manager saves metadata to the database.
Vertical pink double-headed arrow between the Job Manager and Lambda; the job manager invokes Lambda to get clip metadata.
Pink double-headed arrow between Lambda and the S3 bucket; Lambda reads clips in the bucket to extract metadata.

Pink line going down from the G3 icon, running left along the bottom and ending with an arrowhead pointing up at S3; the asset manager copies output clips back to the customer's bucket (and copies inputs from it).
